activity_summary: At home you said the jacks leap to kiss the player's hand, and that a man stands envying dead wood. You said you are not asking her name. You stopped. You did not speak a line of verse.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the three sentences and did not speak the lines he meant to write.

facets.activity: Spoke of the jacks and stopped

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The jacks leap to kiss the hand that plays.
